verdict.rationale: Context.dev documents scrape-time browser actions (click, wait, scroll before capture), but nothing shows a managed remote browser session that a developer can drive interactively or manually. The axis applies to a web-data and scraping API, and pre-scrape actions are an adjacent feature, so they earn no credit here.

support.subject: As a developer, I can access a managed remote browser sandbox for interactive, manual browsing workflows
